branch.description: Create a feature branch based on specification
branch.template: Create a feature branch based on the specification file at `.opencode/specifications/`. Read the spec to understand the work, then create and checkout a branch with an appropriate name.

next-step.template: Analyze the specification and current codebase. Propose ONE atomic, verifiable, buildable and testable task that advances the implementation. Present the task and ask for confirmation before proceeding.

commit.template: Review the current git changes (staged and unstaged). Propose and create a commit with an appropriate message.

test.template: Add tests to the codebase. Skills: angular-component-testing, e2e-testing, vitest-testing

refactor.description: Refactor code while maintaining business logic
refactor.template: Refactor code while maintaining business logic. Use skill: refactoring

docs.template: Check if documentation is up-to-date and update if needed. Use skill: docs
